title: Three Weeks and One Short Postcard
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：landscape　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 landscape 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the painter ① painted the landscape that no traveller in the region would have recorded, and he said the painting was the whole of the week. The ② landscape, meaning the view itself and not the postcard, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; a landscape, he said, is the only thing in a region that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ landscape in that region had the same short postcard beside it, and the ④ landscape at the far terrace, meaning the sketch they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A landscape, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the painter said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the landscape was the whole of the matter, meaning the memory and not the view. The ⑥ landscape, meaning the memory and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; landscape, he said, is either something you paint or the only word that means both a view and a memory. He said the memory is the part they remember.

By 1994 the ⑦ landscape had become a line in a guidebook, and the guidebook had become an argument about the short postcard. The ⑧ landscape of the whole thing, the painter wrote in July, was one region and three weeks of recording; landscape, he said, is either the sketch at the far terrace or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ landscape I remember is the view recorded in the guidebook, which closed in 1996 and is still recorded as the quietest in the region. A ⑩ landscape, my mother said in 1998, is the only view that improves by being recorded; every landscape, she said, is a memory that has agreed to look like a view. She said the memory was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 风景；地貌（指山乡里每一片旁边的那一片）
B. n. 风景；地貌（指那片风景本身，与明信片相对）
C. 固定搭配：paint the landscape 描画这片风景
D. n. 风景；地貌（指留给孩子们留着的那幅速写那一片）
E. n. 游历之事（抽象总称，指一处山乡的风景之事）
F. n. 风景；地貌（指旅行手册里写到、被记载的的那一片）
G. n. 记忆、印象（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 印象（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: painted the landscape that no traveller in the region would have recorded
The landscape, meaning the view itself and not the postcard
the landscape at the far terrace
the landscape was the whole of the matter
the landscape had become a line in a guidebook
The landscape of the whole thing
A landscape, my mother said in 1998

answers.why: paint the landscape 意为“描画这片风景”，1989 年那位写生者把山乡里没有一位旅人肯记载的一片风景做了一遍。
landscape 意为“风景；地貌”，指那片风景本身而不是明信片，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记载。
landscape 意为“风景；地貌”，指山乡里每一片旁边的那一片，每一片旁边都有同一张小小的明信片。
landscape 意为“风景；地貌”，指最远那处观景台留给孩子们留着的那幅速写那一片，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
landscape 意为“记忆、印象”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这段记忆就是那件事的全部。
landscape 意为“印象”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那片风景，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
landscape 意为“风景；地貌”，指旅行手册里写到、被记载的的那一片，到 1994 年这一片成了旅行手册里的一行。
landscape 意为“游历之事”，写生者七月写道，整件事的风景之事是一处山乡和三个星期的记载。
landscape 意为“风景；地貌”，我记得的是旅行手册里记载过的那一片，1996 年画完了，至今仍被说成山乡里最安静的一片。
landscape 为抽象总称，母亲 1998 年说，风景是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的风景。
